title: How grandmother came to love him

plan.english: Grandmother, how did you come to love grandfather? He was a shepherd, and he kept silent the whole day. But in the evening he sang by the river. What did he sing? A song of my eyes. He left a flower on my path. And then you loved him? Then I loved him, and I still cherish him; he is dead. And you, child: is some young man dear to you? Of-Goodly-Fame is dear to me. Then may he sing for you.
